question: Does fitting the source-output subspace to every pre-semantic token position recover a selective functional rank that per-row averaging erased?

authority.failure: Per-row-mean SVD rank 8 explains about .99 of its training object but only .627/.644 of fresh causal response; DIM is still weaker, while all projected arms are selective.

novelty: First all-position source-output SVD rank ladder at the five-module two-task boundary, with a high-rank complement and frozen controls.
decision: Select the lowest rank that is functional; release only if it is also selective and its rank-64 complement is insufficient.
